data.title: Cove Boulevard
data.about:
Cove Boulevard by Imtiaz is a signature development in the heart of Dubailand Residence Complex (DLRC), offering an elevated lifestyle through refined design and thoughtful functionality. Rising 34 floors high, this modern mixed-use tower features studio, 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments alongside premium office spaces, perfectly tailored for professionals and families seeking seamless integration between work and life.

With highlights like a rooftop infinity pool, fully equipped gyms, and serene outdoor retreats, the project blends luxury, wellness, and connectivity into one cohesive living experience. Cove Boulevard by Imtiaz Developments stands out not just for its prime address and stunning amenities but also for its attractive pricing, long-term value, and trusted developer reputation, making it a compelling choice for both investors and end-users.

characteristics_module.title: Imtiaz Cove Boulevard – Where Prestige, Location, and Lifestyle Come Together
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Location in DLRC – Located in the fast-growing Dubailand Residence Complex, offering easy access to key Dubai landmarks.
  • Signature Imtiaz Design – Developed by Imtiaz Developments, known for delivering premium residences with attention to detail.
  • Flexible Payment Options – Choose between two well-structured payment plans designed to suit different buyer needs.
  • High Rental Yield Potential – Benefit from strong ROI in a thriving residential and business hub.
  • All-in-One Lifestyle Destination – Live, work, and relax in a single address with offices and residential units.
  • Wellness-Inspired Amenities – Features like a rooftop infinity pool, outdoor yoga retreat, and elevated gardens redefine modern living.
  • Family-Centric Facilities – Includes kids' play areas, family pool, clubhouse, and BBQ zones for quality family time.
  • Prestigious Office Spaces – High-ceiling, sunlit workspaces with dedicated business lounges and parking.

location_tile.title: Central Connectivity With a Community Focus
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Cove Boulevard by Imtiaz at DLRC is ideally situated in Dubailand Residence Complex, offering residents seamless access to major roads like Dubai – Al Ain Road (E66). This vibrant community is surrounded by top educational institutions, leisure destinations, and commercial zones—perfect for families and professionals alike. The location supports a connected lifestyle with everything you need just minutes away.

  • 5 Minutes – Dubai Outlet Mall
  • 5 Minutes – Academic City
  • 5 Minutes – Global Village
  • 12 Minutes – Desert Palm Polo Club
  • 20 Minutes – Dubai Intl. Airport
  • 20 Minutes – Downtown Dubai
